text: Kamloops and Sun Peaks trails: notes from the Kamloops Mountain Bike Trail Association, Tourism Kamloops, the City's Bike Ranch map and Sun Peaks Resort on 123 bike trails and 7 hikes. Rattlesnake at the Bike Ranch now shows blue as the City rates it, 7 more trails show which way they're ridden, and Family Man at Sun Peaks no longer shows as a bike park trail.
